purpose: Generate one visually consistent transparent 3D icon for the RelayAir app while preserving each asset's established subject and color identity.
generation_instructions: Generate exactly one image: the asset whose asset_id matches generation_request.target_asset. Treat the other catalog entries as context for sibling consistency only; never render a collage or a set of icons.
Keep shared_style and global_constraints fixed for every asset. Use the selected catalog entry for the subject, arrangement, palette, and required details.

When the matching current icon is attached as a reference, preserve its recognizable subject, silhouette, and dominant colors. Replace its finish, camera, lighting, framing, and background with the shared style defined here.
Change only generation_request.target_asset and generation_request.reference_asset_id between runs.

shared_style.art_direction: A premium, softly rounded 3D miniature product icon: simple sculpted forms, clear silhouette, gentle depth, and a calm handcrafted finish. All eleven images should read as siblings from one designed icon family.

geometry.detail_level: Low to medium; favor a few broad, clean forms over tiny details.
geometry.edges: Use consistent soft bevels and rounded corners throughout the set.
geometry.surface_detail: Smooth, nearly texture-free surfaces; keep seams, grooves, and embossing broad enough to read at small size.
geometry.proportions: Product-like miniature proportions, simplified without distorting the subject.

camera.focus: Entire subject sharp; no depth-of-field blur.
camera.rule: Keep the camera fixed across the set. Rotate or tilt the object itself only as specified by its catalog entry.

composition.placement: One centered icon composition with balanced visual weight.
composition.scale: The full silhouette occupies about 72–78% of the canvas at its longest dimension, with at least 10% clear margin on every side.
composition.cropping: Keep every part fully inside the canvas. Preserve each subject's natural orientation.

background.alpha: Real transparent pixels outside the subject; do not simulate transparency with a checkerboard.

materials.overall_finish: Matte to soft satin, with broad restrained highlights.
materials.material_logic: Use simple subject-appropriate material cues while keeping the same soft, non-photoreal finish across the family.
materials.metal_accents: Muted and satin; no mirror-like metal.
materials.texture: No photoreal grain, leather pores, paper fibers, scratches, or noise.

lighting.rig: Consistent soft studio setup for every icon.
lighting.key: Large diffused light from the upper left.
lighting.fill: Gentle neutral fill to preserve readable color and form.
lighting.rim: Very subtle edge separation only when needed.
lighting.shadows: Soft form shading and mild ambient occlusion contained within the subject; no cast shadow outside it.
lighting.avoid: Hard spotlights, dramatic contrast, colored environment light, glow, bloom, and glossy reflections.

output.preferred_resolution: 1024 x 1024 pixels or the highest available square output.
output.intended_display_size: About 84 points; keep the silhouette and required details legible when reduced.

asset_catalog.subject: A single landscape payment card with naturally rounded bank-card proportions and a softly beveled edge.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Face the card toward the viewer in a restrained three-quarter view; keep its long edge horizontal with only a slight tilt.
asset_catalog.palette: Cobalt blue card body, subtle cyan-blue edge, muted warm-gold chip and contactless mark.

asset_catalog.subject: One closed upright passport booklet, with softly rounded cover corners and a small visible ivory page edge.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Show the front cover in a restrained three-quarter view; keep the booklet upright and fully in frame.
asset_catalog.palette: Deep violet and plum cover, warm ivory pages, restrained muted-gold emblem.
required_details: A small generic biometric passport mark

asset_catalog.subject: One folded warm-ivory map with broad, simplified muted-teal map areas or route lines and one prominent location pin.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Show the folds and map face clearly in a shallow three-quarter view; place the pin on the map as the main focal detail.
asset_catalog.palette: Warm ivory map, muted teal map details, coral-red location pin with a small ivory center.

asset_catalog.subject: One upright rounded document tile with three broad raised content lines and a circular plus badge overlapping its lower-right corner.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Keep the document facing the viewer in a restrained three-quarter view; make the plus badge distinct without obscuring the document silhouette.
asset_catalog.palette: Rich magenta document, warm-ivory content lines and plus symbol, mustard-yellow badge.
required_details: One plus badge at lower right
exclude: Shadows or effects outside the silhouette

asset_catalog.subject: One upright coral-red waste bin with a separate lid and a simple raised handle.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Show the bin in a restrained three-quarter view; use a few broad vertical grooves so it reads clearly as a waste bin at small size.
asset_catalog.palette: Coral red to warm red throughout, with darker red form shading and no contrasting extra accent.

asset_catalog.subject: One folded paper airplane made from simple broad planes, with a clear central fold.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Aim the nose diagonally upward and to the right; keep the full airplane inside the square canvas.
asset_catalog.palette: Warm orange paper with one warm-ivory inner fold; soft tonal shading only.

asset_catalog.subject: One simple editing icon composition: a warm-ivory document sheet with three shallow lines and one deep-violet pencil laid diagonally across it.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Angle the pencil from lower left to upper right. Keep the document and pencil together as one compact, centered icon composition.
asset_catalog.palette: Warm-ivory document, deep-violet pencil, natural warm-wood pencil tip, muted-gold ferrule.

asset_catalog.subject: One upright modern smartphone representing automatic system appearance.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Show the phone in the locked front three-quarter view. Split its screen into two broad, clean vertical halves: warm light on the left and dark charcoal on the right.
asset_catalog.palette: Soft satin silver frame, warm linen light half, near-black dark half, a muted-gold sun mark and a pale-lavender crescent mark.
required_details: One simple sun mark and one simple crescent mark contained on the screen

asset_catalog.subject: One sculpted sun with a broad round center and a small number of thick, softly rounded rays.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Center the full sun silhouette in the square canvas, facing the viewer with restrained three-dimensional depth.
asset_catalog.palette: Warm muted gold and amber, with broad ivory highlights and soft orange-gold form shading.

asset_catalog.subject: One thick sculpted crescent moon with a clear open inner curve.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Center the full crescent in the square canvas, tilted slightly toward the upper right while retaining the family's restrained three-dimensional depth.
asset_catalog.palette: Deep violet and muted indigo with soft lavender highlights and calm shaded edges.
required_details: Readable open curve at small size

asset_catalog.subject: Two overlapping document sheets with one circular checkmark badge spanning their lower-right area, representing related documents grouped for one form.
asset_catalog.arrangement: Keep the documents upright in a restrained three-quarter view, with both sheets visible and the checkmark distinct at small size.
asset_catalog.palette: Warm-ivory front sheet, pale muted-blue rear sheet, cobalt-blue badge, warm-ivory checkmark and content lines.

always: Render only the selected asset and its explicitly described integral components.
Maintain the locked camera, framing, lighting, geometry, and finish across all eleven outputs.
Preserve each selected subject's established identity and palette while simplifying small details.
Keep the silhouette clean and recognizable at about 84 points.
never: Glossy plastic, sharp specular streaks, or mirror reflections
A floor, base, pedestal, scene, backdrop, vignette, halo, or cast shadow
Text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or unrequested symbols
Extra objects, decorative particles, dramatic perspective, or depth-of-field blur
Cropping or placing any part outside the transparent canvas

quality_targets.color_harmony: Keep each established asset palette; use warm ivory and soft shading to unify the family
quality_targets.alpha_edges: Clean, smooth, and fully transparent outside the artwork
